user.title: Sign in to Layla
user.description: The email and password you use in the Layla app. The password is used once, to sign in, and isn't stored.

advanced.name: Advanced: where to sign in
advanced.description: Layla's web app uses these values. Change them only if Layla gives you a client or address of your own.

data_description.api_url: Layla's REST API. Leave it as it is unless Layla gives you another.
data_description.region: The AWS region of Layla's sign-in service.
data_description.user_pool_id: Layla's sign-in user pool. It starts with the region.
data_description.client_id: The app client to sign in with. The default is the one Layla's web app uses; use another if Layla gives you one.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Layla again
reauth_confirm.description: Layla ended the session for {email}. Enter the password to sign in again.

error.invalid_auth: Layla didn't accept that email and password.
error.mfa: This account has two-step verification on, which this integration can't answer yet.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Layla. Try again in a minute.
error.invalid_endpoints: Layla's sign-in service doesn't know that user pool or app client, or the client doesn't allow signing in with a password.
error.invalid_api_url: The API address has to start with https://.
error.invalid_region: That doesn't look like an AWS region (for example eu-west-1).
error.invalid_user_pool_id: The user pool ID has to start with the region and an underscore (for example eu-west-1_…).
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong; the Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This Layla account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That's a different Layla account from the one set up here.

init.title: Layla options
init.description: Saving reloads the integration. Entities for readings or alarms you turn off are removed.

data.property_in_name: Put the property's name in front of each device's name
data.device_alarms: Also create sensors for the alarms turned on for each device in Layla, and for any alarm that fires

data_description.update_minutes: Each update is one request for your account's settings, one for your properties and one per property. Layla's sensors report about every 5 minutes.
data_description.online_minutes: Layla doesn't say whether a sensor is connected, so it counts as online if it sent a reading this recently.
data_description.properties: Leave all unticked to include every property, including ones you add later. Devices in properties you leave out are removed.
data_description.property_in_name: Useful when several properties have a device with the same name. Entity IDs don't change.
data_description.readings: A sensor is only created for readings the device actually reports.
data_description.alarms: Each one is on while the alarm is active, including while it's snoozed in Layla.
data_description.device_alarms: Once a device has a sensor for an alarm, it keeps it (off while the alarm isn't active). Turn this off to get exactly the alarms chosen above.
